svg.title: Spatial Understanding — Three-Body
svg.desc: On the golden sea nineteen years earlier, where on the large ship is the circular helipad located? A. On the starboard deck B. At the stern C. In the middle of the ship D. On the port deck E. On top of the bridge F. At the bow Answer: F.
